How to play

  • Every down is simulated, but routine downs fast-forward. The broadcast stops on about 20 Key Plays (3rd/4th downs, red zone, deep shots, late spread swings, Tossman dropbacks). Flags can only be thrown on Key Plays.
  • Key Plays run at real speed (about 4–8 seconds). Watch to the whistle, then an Outcome card shows what happened and what it does to your margin. Then you decide: options like "Pass interference, defense (negates INT)" or "Holding, offense (wipes out first down)" show exactly what each call changes, its heat, and whether it's ✓ legit or ✗ invented. Or Let it stand. Use 🔁 Replay (½ speed, free) any time. No timer.
  • Routine downs fast-forward; tap ⏭ Skip to next key play to jump ahead.
  • Holding wipes out a gain. PI and roughing hand out yards and a first down. Spot Fudge flips a close spot. Run Clock burns time.
  • When a real foul happens you see it through the ref's eyes: a yellow ring and a callout like "HOLDING — #75 grabbed the rusher". Calling what you saw cools heat; inventing or upgrading a call raises it; missing a visible foul raises it a little. Clean plays show a subtle ✓ Clean play cue.
  • Heat 100 = fired. Over 80 at the final gun = league review.
  • The House ticker under the broadcast shows the margin. Keep it in the green.
